name: Dungeon Core Master
source:
This Visual Novel follows the story of Stevyn, an experienced adventurer, alongside his companions as they take on a seemingly simple quest. However, things don't go as they hoped for...

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2670900/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
经验丰富的冒险者斯特文与伙伴们接下了一份看似简单的委托。可接下来的事，远没有他们希望的那么顺利…

［摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2670900/]Steam[/url]］
